coordinated_activities.activity: Working a night shift as a part-time aged-care support worker at the residential aged-care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning, hydration and medication reminders, and writing up detailed handover notes for the morning staff
Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, checking text messages and reviewing the written shift handover on his phone while travelling
Making a light breakfast after the night shift, toasting bread, boiling the kettle for a cup of tea, and quietly putting away his work bag and uniform
Showering, washing up and changing out of his work clothes, then rinsing his uniform in the basin to wash properly later
Closing the curtains, turning on the fan for steady background noise, setting his phone to silent with a written reminder for the afternoon, and preparing for daytime sleep after the night shift
Sleeping during the day after the night shift, keeping the room dark and quiet for recovery
Waking up and eating a late flexitarian lunch of rice, lentils and vegetables, reheating it in the microwave and drinking a cup of tea while sitting quietly
Doing a load of laundry in the washing machine, including his aged-care uniform, and setting the dehumidifier to help things dry indoors
Sitting at his desk with the desk lamp on, working through written university readings and notes on the computer for his Master of Social Work coursework
Cooking dinner in batches, preparing a flexitarian meal with vegetables and tofu in the induction cooker and rice in the rice cooker
Eating dinner and drinking tea, then packing a portion into a container in the refrigerator for the next shift
Cleaning the bench and cooktop, wiping down the appliances he used and loading the dishwasher
Moving the laundry to the clothes dryer, folding the dried washing in the bathroom and tidying his towel and toiletries
Tracking his weekly budget in a written notebook, counting out cash for the week's shared bills and confirming upcoming rent and utility amounts
Drafting a written agenda for the next house meeting and typing detailed text-only messages to confirm quiet hours and shared plans in advance
Boiling the kettle for a last cup of tea and preparing a simple breakfast and snack to take to tomorrow's placement
Evening washing routine, brushing his teeth and taking a warm shower before bed
Looking at a saved photo of his family dog in China on his phone, reading a few pages of a book and winding down under the fan
Sleeping, having set his written reminders and alarm for the next day's shift and study tasks
